name: Eva
short_zh: “成为一颗龙舌兰，挡住人生的风浪“，我觉得悬崖花园主人阿桑最强大的地方，在于永远相信自己，美好有力量，感染到了更多的人。
short_en: Be like an agave, standing resilient against the storms of life.' I believe her greatest strength lies in her unwavering belief in herself. The beauty she creates possesses a quiet power that deeply inspires everyone it touches
full_zh: 在涠洲岛的悬崖花园，作为客人只感受到风平浪静的时候，但当我们看到了阿桑种活的一座花园，真是非常佩服。”成为一颗龙舌兰，挡住人生的风浪“，我觉得她最强大的地方，在于永远相信自己，美好有力量，感染到了更多的人。
full_en: At the Cliff Garden on Weizhou Island, guests often only perceive the calm and tranquility. But upon seeing the vibrant garden that A Sang has nurtured to life, one is filled with profound admiration. 'Be like an agave, standing resilient against the storms of life.' I believe her greatest strength lies in her unwavering belief in herself. The beauty she creates possesses a quiet power that deeply inspires everyone it touches

name: 郝蕊
short_zh: 涠洲岛，最美的风景是人
short_en: On Weizhou, the most beautiful scenery is the people
full_zh:
为什么涠洲岛近年不断被热捧？这次岛上三天所见所得，让人想说那句话“涠洲岛，最美的风景是人”😜

除了帅哥阿亮和小姐姐阿桑，还要感谢只做一桌好饭专门给我们吃的小宸姐，让我们包场环岛咖啡的阿昊，以及默默陪伴的润夏等等。

是你们的坚守、奋斗、热诚和纯善，才终将涠洲岛的美好与珍贵一一呈现。

与你们面对面的交流，让我们的旅程，不仅有美有爱，还拥有真实又独特的故事性。

谢谢！
full_en:
Why has Weizhou been so loved lately? Three days on the island left me wanting to say it out loud: “On Weizhou, the most beautiful scenery is the people.” 😜

Besides Aliang and Asang, thank you to Sister Xiaochen for cooking a table just for us, to Ahao for letting us book out the island café, and to Runxia for quietly walking with us.

Your perseverance, hard work, warmth and kindness are what bring Weizhou’s beauty into view, piece by piece.

Talking face to face with you made our trip not only beautiful and full of care, but also truly and uniquely storied.

Thank you!

name: 【萌娃探中国】团队会员
short_zh: 刚刚仔仔很认真的跟我说，妈妈明年我还想来桂林，还想找大师姐。孩子发自内心的喜欢，就是最好的证明。
short_en: Just now, my son told me very seriously, 'Mom, I want to come back to Guilin next year, and I want to travel with Big Sister again.' A child's heartfelt affection is the greatest testament of all.
full_zh: 这是我初次带孩子参加亲子研学营，出发前内心颇多忐忑，既担心形成节奏不适合孩子，也怕旅行只是流于表面的观光。但这趟桂林之行，在小伍大师姐和团队的悉心统筹与全程陪伴下，所有顾虑都彻底打消。行程处处用心，诸多细节都处理得十分妥帖，让人倍感温暖。我想，最好的评价莫过于孩子最真实的反馈。刚刚仔仔很认真的跟我说，妈妈明年我还想来桂林，还想找大师姐。孩子发自内心的喜欢，就是最好的证明。
full_en: This was my first time taking my child on a family educational camp. I was quite anxious before departure, worrying that the pace might not suit him and fearing the trip would just be superficial sightseeing. However, during this trip to Guilin, all my concerns were completely dispelled thanks to the meticulous coordination and constant companionship of 'Xiao Wu Big Sister' and the team. Thoughtfulness was evident throughout the entire itinerary, and so many details were handled perfectly, making us feel incredibly cared for. I believe the best review comes from a child's most authentic feedback. Just now, my son told me very seriously, 'Mom, I want to come back to Guilin next year, and I want to travel with Big Sister again.' A child's heartfelt affection is the greatest testament of all.

name: Melarie
short_zh: 非常感谢你为我们规划行程、预订酒店和火车票，如此迅速地解答我的所有问题，如此灵活地帮我们修改行程并重新预订火车票。
short_en: Thank you very much for organising our trip, booking our hotels and train tickets, answering all my questions so quickly, for being so flexible and changing the itinerary, rebooking the train tickets
full_zh: 谢谢你，Chanel 💖 非常感谢你为我们规划行程、预订酒店和火车票，如此迅速地解答我的所有问题，如此灵活地帮我们修改行程并重新预订火车票。感谢你非常慷慨的礼物，以及你的可爱、友善和体贴。
full_en: Thank you Chanel 💖 Thank you very much for organising our trip, booking our hotels and train tickets, answering all my questions so quickly, for being so flexible and changing the itinerary, rebooking the train tickets, for your very generous gift, and being so lovely, kind and considerate.

name: Michelle T.
short_zh: 过境出乎意料地顺利，向导对当地历史的了解令人佩服。
short_en: The border crossing was seamless, and our guide's knowledge of local history was remarkable.
full_zh: 我以为跨境会很麻烦，但向导处理了一切。沙坝的早晨是整个旅程的亮点——我们在迷雾中徒步，感觉就像走进了另一个世界。越南咖啡让我上瘾了，已经在网上找了好几种豆子回来复刻。总体上性价比极高，会推荐给所有想要深度游的朋友。
full_en: I thought the border crossing would be complicated, but the guide handled everything. The Sapa morning was the trip's highlight — trekking through mist felt like stepping into another world. I got addicted to Vietnamese coffee and have been sourcing beans to recreate it at home. Exceptional value overall. I'll recommend this to every friend who wants a deep travel experience.

name: 【萌娃探中国】团队会员
short_zh: 行程安排贴心细致，方方面面都照顾到大人和孩子，也辛苦大师姐一路抓拍记录下很多珍贵瞬间。
short_en: The itinerary was meticulous and considerate, taking great care of both adults and children in every respect. A special thanks to 'Big Sister' for capturing so many precious moments on camera for us throughout the journey.
full_zh:
感谢大师姐小伍和团队这五天的悉心陪伴与用心安排❤️
整个桂林亲子之旅充实又有意义，不只是走马观花看山水，摘百香果、搭建吊脚楼、鸬鹚夜捕、坐漓江竹筏感受“人在画中游”和岩洞飞拉达这些沉浸式体验，还有参观百年老屋听八旬句老奶奶讲诉170年老屋的岁月，让孩子在玩乐当中增长见识、收获成长。
行程安排贴心细致，方方面面都照顾到大人和孩子，也辛苦大师姐一路抓拍记录下很多珍贵瞬间。
山水一程，收获满满，非常愉快的一次出行！些许不周完全谈不上，非常感谢你们的付出。
祝团队一切顺遂，期待未来有缘再次相逢大美桂林！
full_en:
"Thank you to 'Big Sister', Xiao Wu, and the team for your attentive company and thoughtful arrangements over the past five days. ❤️
Our Guilin family trip was incredibly fulfilling and meaningful. It was far more than just a quick glance at the scenery. We enjoyed immersive experiences like picking passion fruit, building traditional stilt houses, night fishing with cormorants, riding bamboo rafts on the Li River (truly feeling like 'traveling within a painting'), and cave via ferrata. We also visited a century-old house where an 80-year-old grandmother shared the 170-year history of the home, allowing the children to learn and grow while having fun.
The itinerary was meticulous and considerate, taking great care of both adults and children in every respect. A special thanks to 'Big Sister' for capturing so many precious moments on camera for us throughout the journey.
A deeply rewarding journey through the mountains and rivers, and an exceptionally pleasant trip! We couldn't have asked for anything more, and we are so grateful for your hard work.
Wishing the team all the best, and we look forward to crossing paths again in beautiful Guilin in the future!”

name: 匿名
short_zh: 在英语导游的帮助下，我们了解了这个迷人国家传统与现代的生活方式。
short_en: With the assistance of our English speaking guides we learnt of the traditional and modern way of life in this fascinating country.
full_zh:
轮椅上的中国精华游
去中国旅游是我那需要坐轮椅的丈夫的愿望清单之一。尽管我们对无障碍设施有所担忧，但得知Chanel能够帮我们实现这个愿望时，我们感到非常惊喜，而且她确实做到了。
在英语导游的帮助下，我们了解了这个迷人国家传统与现代的生活方式。
Alex是我们从北京到上海这14天精华游全程的导游，他非常努力地确保我丈夫能够安全地体验尽可能多的历史、地理和文化风情。Chanel则在幕后确保每一个细节都考虑周全。
我们对这家公司印象极其深刻，并且愿意再次与他们一起前往亚洲旅游。
full_en:
Highlights tour of China with a wheelchair
A visit to China was on the bucket list of my husband who is confined to a wheelchair. Despite our concerns about accessibility, we were pleasantly surprised to learn that Chanel could make it happen and she did.
With the assistance of our English speaking guides we learnt of the traditional and modern way of life in this fascinating country.
Alex, our guide throughout our entire 14 day highlights journey from Beijing to Shanghai worked extremely hard to ensure my husband could safely experience as much of the historic, geographic and cultural aspects as possible. Chanel was behind the scenes ensuring every detail was considered.
We were extremely impressed with this company and would travel with them to Asia again.
